body_lead: Mumbai: In a bid to enhance security and streamline visitor management at Mantralaya, Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis has directed officials to implement advanced AI technology. The decision was announced during a cabinet meeting on Thursday. “Our aim is not to reduce the footfall at Mantralaya but to ensure that every individual entering the premises is properly identified,” Fadnavis said. He explained that a new system would be introduced, enabling visitors to register online and receive an entry slip. This slip must be presented at the entry gate and submitted upon exit.
